subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding request — MerchantCo trial
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@merchantco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding for 30-day pilot — invoice only?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — MerchantCo is excited to run a 30-day pilot (approx $1,200/month) starting next week. Our procurement team is tight on timelines and asked whether we can onboard without a PO for this initial month and take invoice-only terms, with PO to follow once the pilot moves to paid scale.

Attached is our onboarding form and W-9. Can Redwood accommodate an interim invoice path so we can get started Monday? If you need a purchase order or vendor code to proceed, let me know and I can escalate on my side.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | MerchantCo
[Attachment: MerchantCo_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: W9_MerchantCo.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@merchantco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding for 30-day pilot — invoice only?

Hi Marta — appreciate the quick turnaround and the docs.

Quick update: we can often provide a temporary invoice-only onboarding for short pilots, but we require a small set of evidence and a formal short-term approval internally (limit on spend and 30-day window). I’m looping in Procurement (Laura) and Finance (Ben) to confirm.

Requested items for the approval path:
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- Valid W-9 (received)
- Primary billing contact and PO ETA (if available)
- Trial estimated monthly spend ($1,200) and expected go/no-go date at 30 days

If Procurement signs off, we can make the pilot live while we finalize the MSA/PO. Would you be able to confirm the billing contact and the exact go/no-go date?

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I hear back from Laura/Ben.

— Jonas
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding for 30-day pilot — invoice only?

Jonas — copying Priyom from vendor onboarding for intake notes.

Summary of recommended approach (procurement):
- Approve temporary invoice-only onboarding for up to 30 days contingent on the following controls:
  1) Spend cap set to $5,000 for the 30-day window (covers the pilot and any overages)
  2) Billing contact and email on file for invoice delivery (required)
  3) Finance to issue a one-time invoice cadence (Net 30) and track in our interim vendor queue
  4) Vendor must sign the standard MSA via DocuSign within 14 calendar days — if unsigned, suspension of services after the 30-day pilot
  5) Security/compliance check: vendor integrates no PII for the pilot or provides evidence of data handling policy (light check)

Evidence we have/probably need:
- MerchantCo_onboarding_form.pdf — OK
- W9_MerchantCo.pdf — OK
- Proof of contact and billing address — need confirmation from Marta
- Basic SOC/ISO statement or data handling note — request from vendor (can be lightweight for trial)

If Ben and Priyom are comfortable with the cap and controls, we’ll provide a formal approval memo and a temporary vendor code so Operations can route invoices. Priyom — can you create the onboarding ticket and attach the checklist (I’ll send the signed memo once Procurement approves)?

Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-06-29T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: 30-day invoice-only onboarding (MerchantCo)

Hi Marta — good news. Procurement approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for MerchantCo for a single 30-day pilot window under the controls below:

What’s approved:
- Interim path: invoice-only for 30 days starting upon provisioning
- Spend cap: $5,000 total for the pilot period
- Billing cadence: Net 30 invoices to the billing contact you provide
- Required: sign MSA via DocuSign within 14 days of service activation (link below)
- Security: provide a brief data handling note or SOC statement prior to activation (can be a short email if you don’t have a full report)

Next steps (on your side):
1) Confirm primary billing contact and email (so Finance can route invoices).
2) Sign the MSA: https://docusign.net/transaction/ABC123-MerchantCo-MSA
3) Provide a one-paragraph data handling note if available.

Attachments enclosed: redwood-temp-no-po-approval-20260629.pdf (formal memo). Once we get your billing contact and signed MSA, Ops will create a temporary vendor code and enable the pilot.

If any of the controls are a blocker, tell me ASAP — otherwise we’ll plan to provision next business day after your sign-off.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-temp-no-po-approval-20260629.pdf (pdf)]
